name: Coordinates by Another Name
description: Compose band, block, and count designations to find and sink an unknown fleet. Shots reveal a persistent chart of evidence.
natural_language: Sink every vessel with as few shots as possible. Compose a band, block, and count on the console, then fire. Arrows on block brackets show the count direction. A star count sweeps one entire block run; sweep charges are limited. Vessels are straight and occupy adjacent chart cells. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with unrelated, blank, settings, or pre-existing non-task tabs. Only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task are allowed, using their visible controls only.

metadata.notes: Original irregular symbolic chart. Persistent evidence means temporal memory is not required. Public browser play is inspectable exploration, not secret evaluation.
